purpose: Send the Crown's Resident to this governor's town
note: Issue 393, the-diplomat.md section 7: he can only cultivate the governor he lives with, which gives the PC a reason to move him TOWARD trouble. The composer offers recipients and nothing else, so the PC chooses the town by choosing its governor - the letter is to him, and the Order in it is addressed to the Diplomat, who decides whether to go exactly as he decides everything. The gold is section 3's: a move costs the Crown the journey, whoever asked for it.

options.text: with news I hope you will welcome
to tell you of an arrangement
because I do not know what else to send you

options.label: send the Resident to {param:town}
options.text: The Crown's Resident will be coming to {param:town}, and I should take it kindly if you made him welcome at your table{insert:edge}. He will be a guest of yours for some time.
